opening.argument: The video is plainly presented as Bihar election news and political coverage. Its title identifies a Bihar election opinion poll and names political figures, while the narration states that “the biggest news of this time is related to the Bihar elections” [1][2]. It reports an open challenge between Tejashwi Yadav and Nitish Kumar, reinforcing that the subject is political debate and election activity rather than a financial offer [3]. The visible political stage, alliance banner, speakers, raised hands, and news-style presentation fit that coverage. Requests to like, subscribe, and comment are ordinary audience-engagement prompts; they do not amount to financial solicitation or establish deceptive acquisition.
